Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring firearms dealers to install antitheft devices.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to installation of antitheft devices by federallylicensed firearms dealers; adding a new section to chapter 9.41 RCW;and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.41 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) On and after April 1, 2004, a dealer shall maintain in workingorder, within the building designated in the dealer's license issuedunder RCW 9.41.110, an antitheft system intended to prevent theft offirearms. (2) The Washington state patrol shall by rule maintain a list ofapproved antitheft systems. In addition to other criteria identifiedby the Washington state patrol, such antitheft systems must include anaudible alarm that sounds whenever any firearm is taken from thepremises without the knowledge and approval of the dealer. The initiallist of approved antitheft systems shall be adopted by January 1, 2004. (3) A dealer violating subsection (1) of this section is guilty of p. 1 HB 2074a class 1 civil infraction under chapter 7.80 RCW.
